text: {"reasoning": "Read requirements to understand the contract before retuning.", "action": {"tool": "get_requirements", "args": {}}}
cost_basis: list-basis estimate reported by the CLI; actual billing unknown

requirements.text: Mid-band gain at 400 Hz, source impedance 100 ohm, is 1.30 V/V +/-5 %.
Gain at every frequency 50 Hz-1 kHz is within +/-0.5 dB of the 400 Hz gain.
For a 0.5 Vpk input tone at any frequency from 19 kHz to 1 MHz, the output amplitude is <= 1 LSB (0.806 mV peak), i.e. absolute gain <= -55.8 dB.
Quiescent output DC level equals VREF/2 within +/-10 mV (0.6 %) for any supply and VREF in range, with worst-case op-amp offset.
At 1.0 Vpk input (50 Hz-1 kHz) the output stays within 0.10 V ... 3.20 V in all corners; no clipping.
Input impedance magnitude from 50 Hz-1 kHz is >= 10 kohm.

Charge-bucket load settling: with the ADC model sample cap pre-charged to the opposite full-scale level, the voltage on the sample cap at the end of the 1 us acquisition is within 1/2 LSB (0.403 mV) of the settled value.

No unintended peaking: at every frequency from 10 Hz to 10 MHz the simulated AOUT gain does not exceed the ideal-op-amp prediction of the same component values by more than 3 dB (catches op-amp/cap-load instability that the ideal model cannot show). Transient step stability is NOT tested.
Total quiescent supply current <= 1.0 mA at 5 V.
Integrated output noise 1 Hz-20 kHz <= 0.25 LSB rms (0.2 mV).
KiCad ERC: 0 errors, 0 warnings that are not individually waived in writing. KiCad DRC incl. schematic parity: 0 violations, 0 unconnected items, 0 parity issues.
Pin-function audit: every active/polarised part's manufacturer pin function = symbol pin function = footprint pad number, against the transcribed datasheet table (independent of the netlist).
Every BOM line has a manufacturer part number; every active part has a recorded datasheet revision.
2-layer, <= 40 x 30 mm, min track/space 0.15 mm, min drill 0.3 mm, 0.6 mm via; Gerber/drill/position files generated and rendered.

vref.note: supplied by the ADC board on J2.VREF, +/-1 %

temperature.model_coverage: NOT covered: ngspice models run at nominal temperature; no temperature requirement is claimed as met

source_impedance_ohm.note: buffered/line-driver source; adds in series with the 10 k input resistor

interferer.description: out-of-band tone (e.g. switching noise) at or above fs - f_band_hi
